ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 60% of the total visible fluke area consists of high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the lateral lobes, while 40% consists of low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the central hinge and lower peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral high-intensity white geometric zones occupy the outer lobes. These are intersected by a high-density network of low-intensity linear streaks. A dark, low-intensity contiguous region extends vertically from the peduncle to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 85 degrees; depth is significant, creating a clear bisection of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary, appearing as a jagged profile against the sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to distal tips that terminate in sharp, slightly posteriorly-recurved points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white pixel circularity at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle-related scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering approximately 40% of the visible white-pigmented surface on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable reddish/pinkish circular discoloration localized on the outer margin of the left lobe's trailing edge.
